start.title: Teach Us to Pray
start.text:
The disciples approach quietly.
"Lord, teach us how to pray."

choices.feedback: Luke 11:1 — One of Jesus' disciples asked Him to teach them to pray.

loud_consequence.title: Not for Show
loud_consequence.text:
Prayer is not for the crowd.
It is for the Father.

empty_consequence.title: Speak from the Heart
empty_consequence.text:
The Father hears the heart, not noise.
Speak simply.

our_father.title: Our Father
our_father.text:
"Our Father in heaven,
hallowed be your name."

choices.feedback: Matthew 6:9 — Jesus taught His disciples to hallow God's name.

stranger_consequence.title: He Knows You
stranger_consequence.text:
He is near, not distant.
Call him Father.

bread.title: Daily Bread
bread.text:
"Give us this day
our daily bread."

choices.feedback: Matthew 6:11 — Jesus taught His disciples to ask for their daily bread.

hoard_consequence.title: Trust Today
hoard_consequence.text:
Tomorrow is in his hands.
Ask only for now.

greed_consequence.title: Enough Is Enough
greed_consequence.text:
He gives what you need.
That is enough.

forgive.title: Forgive Us
forgive.text:
"Forgive us our debts,
our failings, our sins."

choices.feedback: Matthew 6:12 — Jesus taught His disciples to ask God to forgive their debts.

hide_consequence.title: Come Into Light
hide_consequence.text:
He already knows your heart.
Speak honestly.

forgive_others.title: As We Forgive
forgive_others.text:
"As we also forgive
those who sin against us."

choices.feedback: Matthew 6:12 — Jesus taught His disciples to forgive those who sin against them.

wound_consequence.title: Let Go
wound_consequence.text:
Mercy received must be given.
Open your hand.

demand_consequence.title: Mercy First
demand_consequence.text:
You were forgiven freely.
Forgive freely too.

deliver.title: Deliver Us
deliver.text:
"Lead us not into temptation,
but deliver us from evil."

choices.text: Ask the Father to guard you
choices.feedback: Matthew 6:13 — Jesus taught His disciples to ask God to deliver them from evil.

self_consequence.title: Lean on Him
self_consequence.text:
You are not alone in the storm.
Ask for his help.

choices.text: Ask the Father to guard you

private.title: Go Into Your Room
private.text:
"When you pray, go to your room.
Shut the door. Pray in secret."

choices.feedback: Matthew 6:6 — Jesus taught His disciples to go into their room and shut the door to pray to their Father in secret.

boast_consequence.title: In Secret
boast_consequence.text:
Your Father who sees in secret
will reward you.

ending.title: He Hears You
ending.text:
A small lamp burns beside you.
You are not alone here.
